findings.issue: §7 item 2 claims "Sven diverges only in the param-fraction scans, and only at lr >= 0.5 ... Sven has 0 divergences in every headline scan, in the kappa scan and in all four micro-batch scans." That is true only of the recorded status; under `style.is_diverged` (the definition the same document says at line 422 and 516 "governs selection" and which every analysis table uses) Sven has, recomputed from the raw jsonl with the 10x rule: toy_1d_scan 194 of 900 svd runs (val0 ~1.0 -> 6.5e10, 7.5e17, ... at rtol 1e-6/1e-5), polynomial_scan 4, mnist_scan_labelRegression 1, cifar10_resnet_scan_labelRegression 5, mnist_kappaScan_labelRegression 10 of 210 (doc: "0 diverged", §3.4 line 336), polynomial_microbatch_scan 2, mnist_microbatch_labelreg_scan 1, rebuttal_fig5_cifar_paramfrac_scan 2 (doc table line 533: 0). Cross-checked against the tool itself: `tools/select_best.py` prints "33 diverged run(s), excluded from seed means: {'SGDm': 15, 'SGD': 13, 'SVD': 5}" for cifar10_resnet_scan_labelRegression. Compounding it, the wide-vs-narrow list at line 514 quotes five scans but omits toy_1d_scan, whose delta (289 wide vs 82 recorded) is the largest in the campaign and is 194/207 Sven. As written this is a method-robustness claim that a reviewer can falsify from the released records.
findings.suggested_fix: Qualify item 2 as "as recorded (status)" and add the wide counts per scan for Sven (toy 194/900, kappa 10/210, CIFAR-LR 5/90, poly 4, MNIST-LR 1, poly-microbatch 2, MNIST-microbatch-LR 1, Fig-5 2/15), and add the toy_1d_scan row (289 vs 82) to the wide-vs-narrow list at line 514. Same qualifier needed on §3.4's "210/210, 0 diverged" and on the §7 table's "0" row for the kappa/micro-batch/Fig-5 scans.

findings.issue: The §6 checkpoint-storage column is copied from campaign/grid_counts.md:348-351 (a PRE-LAUNCH estimate) and is contradicted by the files on disk. Claimed vs measured: toy/polynomial log ladder "~94 KB per run" vs 195,489 bytes = 191 KiB (2.1x); the two 200-epoch overparam scans "~563 KB" vs 1,171,311 bytes = 1.1 MiB (2.1x); MNIST "~3.7 MB per svd run, ~9.2 GB for the scan" -- the per-run figure is right (3,980,647 B) but `du -sh experiment_results/mnist_scan_labelRegression/ckpt` = 2.5 GB, not 9.2 GB (grid_counts' 9.2 GB is the campaign-wide total over ~2,490 svd runs, silently re-attributed to one scan); nanoGPT "~165 MB" vs 183,459,050 B = 175 MiB. The document's preamble (line 3, 10-12) asserts every fact was derived from the records.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the estimate column with measured sizes (191 KiB / 1.1 MiB / 3.8 MiB per run, 2.5 GB for mnist_scan_labelRegression's ckpt dir, 175 MiB per nanoGPT run), or label the column "pre-launch estimate (grid_counts.md)".

findings.issue: §4 and §6 contradict each other on the same object. §4 justifies the CIFAR diag policy with "`epochs` on CIFAR, because a `log` ladder is ~0.95 GB per ResNet run"; §6 (line 486) says "`log` keeps every state in RAM until flush -- ~1.6 GB per ResNet run". Measured: the ladder that actually ran in cifar10_resnet_ce_scan_diag is 940,996,941 bytes = 0.94 GB = 21 states x 44.7 MB, i.e. exactly the `epochs` ladder that was CHOSEN. So 0.95 GB is the size of the cheaper option, not of the option being avoided; a `log` ladder over 7,020 steps would be ~33 states ~1.5 GB, which is what §6 says.
findings.suggested_fix: In §4 write "`epochs` on CIFAR (21 states, 0.94 GB per run) because the `log` ladder would be ~33 states / ~1.5 GB", making §4 and §6 consistent.

findings.issue: The phase table's column is labelled "window (UTC)" but two of its four rows are wrong or in another zone. Recomputed from every record's start_time/end_time: main campaign (sv3 2c6faf59) 2026-09-19T00:02:48Z -> 2026-09-20T02:10:43Z, but the table says "-> 09-20 05:36"; 05:36 appears nowhere else in the repo and the last-ending record is job 47080834 in cifar10_resnet_ce_scan at 02:10:43Z. Extension round: records run 2026-09-20T03:34:11Z -> 07:48:53Z, but the table's start "09-19 23:35" is the EDT time (= 09-20 03:35Z), so the row mixes EDT and UTC. Rows 3 and 4 (GPT-2 05:49->21:58Z, phase 5 08:00->14:39Z) are correct UTC. The same defect mirrors into analysis/RERUNS_NEEDED.md's launch-log table, whose header says "date (EDT)": rows 1-3 are EDT, but row 4's "09-20 08:00 -> 09-20 14:39" are the UTC record times (04:00-10:39 EDT).
findings.suggested_fix: Set row 1's end to 09-20 02:10 and row 2's start to 09-20 03:34 (UTC), and in RERUNS_NEEDED convert the phase-5 row to 04:00 -> 10:39 EDT (or label that table UTC and convert rows 1-3).

findings.issue: §9.3 states "Under the corrected evaluation Sven is 9th of 11 on CIFAR label-regression and 10th of 11 on CIFAR-CE" without saying which seed set. Those are the TUNING seeds (reproduced exactly from bench/best_configs.json: label-reg SVD 0.48034 = 9th, CE SVD 1.40281 = 10th), while §5 line 464 declares the CONFIRMATION seeds the headline. Recomputed on the confirmation seeds (55 records per scan, seed-mean final val): label-reg Sven 9th (0.4838), CE Sven 9th (1.4239, with SGDm 1.4311 just behind) -- the CE rank flips on a 0.5% margin. WP2/WP4b, following §5, will publish "9th" for CE and appear to contradict this section.
findings.suggested_fix: Say which seed set the rank is from and give both, e.g. "9th of 11 on label-regression and 10th of 11 on CIFAR-CE on the tuning seeds; 9th of 11 on both on the confirmation seeds (CE: Sven 1.4239 vs SGDm 1.4311)".

findings.issue: §7's mechanism sentence -- "A non-finite training-batch loss raises `DivergedError(step)`, the record is written with `status: diverged` and `diverged_at_step`" -- describes only 1,147 of the 1,422 records whose status is `diverged`. Recomputed over all 43 result dirs: DivergedError 1,147, `_LinAlgError` 243 (all K-FAC), `RuntimeError` 32 (all Sven, the masked-Gram eigh in the paramfrac scans); `_classify_failure` (experiments/experiment_code/generic_scan.py:498-510) maps linalg failures and the "no singular value above rtol"/"failed to converge"/"ill-conditioned" messages to `diverged` with `diverged_at_step: None`. So "0 `error`" is true of the status field while 275 diverged records (19%) carry an exception payload and no step, and any analysis that histograms `diverged_at_step` drops them silently.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one sentence: non-finite loss -> DivergedError with a step (1,147 records); eigendecomposition failures and Sven's empty-spectrum guard are also classified `diverged` but with `diverged_at_step: None` (243 K-FAC `_LinAlgError`, 32 Sven `RuntimeError`), which is why status `error` is 0.

findings.issue: §4 says the 21 companions are "all complete (1,575 runs: 425 timing + 425 diag + 725 confirm, verified)" -- the counts reproduce exactly -- but neither §4 nor §7 mentions that 20 of those 1,575 records are `diverged`: polynomial_scan_confirm 13 of its 15 L-BFGS runs, polynomial_scan_diag 2/5, polynomial_scan_timing 2/5, toy_1d_scan_confirm 1/15, mnist_scan_ce_confirm 1/5, mnist_scan_labelRegression_timing 1/5. §7's divergence table covers only the 21 campaign scans, so a reader takes the passes to be failure-free, and WP2's headline confirmation table for polynomial L-BFGS will rest on 2 surviving seeds of 15.
